unit.label: Study plans, sequence & scholarships
unit.title: How Long Will You Study?
unit.description: Begin this lesson with study plans and duration, 先…再… sequencing, language-center and university study, total time needed, cost, scholarships, and grades.

banner.pinyin: Xiān niàn Zhōngwén, zài niàn dàxué

goal.text: 我先在語言中心念一年，再念四年大學，所以需要五年。
goal.pinyin: Wǒ xiān zài yǔyán zhōngxīn niàn yì nián, zài niàn sì nián dàxué, suǒyǐ xūyào wǔ nián.
goal.meaning: I will first study for one year at a language center, then study at university for four years, so I need five years.

unit.bookReference: A Course in Contemporary Chinese 1 · Lesson 12 「你在臺灣學多久的中文？」 Dialogue I opening / Vocabulary I (printed pp. 246–249) and Grammar I 先…再… (printed p. 252). This unit follows the dialogue through the scholarship/grades exchange. The later Dialogue I tail (學費、公司、替、希望、以後、上班、念書、累、加油), Dialogue II, and Grammar II–IV are deliberately deferred.

lessons.title: How Long Is the Plan?
lessons.subtitle: Formally learn 臺灣, 計畫, 久, and 時間 through the opening question of this lesson.

steps.prompt: In the conversation, what answer follows 你計畫在臺灣學多久的中文？
steps.explanation: The reply is 五年, 'five years.' The next line asks why such a long time.

steps.prompt: Which this lesson word means 'to plan to'?
steps.explanation: 計畫 is the this lesson verb 'to plan to.' Compare the earlier 打算 'plan/intend.'

lessons.title: First This, Then That
lessons.subtitle: Learn 先, 念, and the sequence pattern 先…再….

steps.prompt: Which word marks the action that happens first?
steps.explanation: 先 goes before the first event; 再 introduces the next event.

steps.prompt: In this lesson, 念中文 means…
steps.explanation: In Taiwan Mandarin, 念 can mean to study, as in 念中文 and 念大學.

lessons.title: Language Center, Then University
lessons.subtitle: Build 語言中心 into the full study sequence and reinforce 大學.

tokens: 我先在語言中心念一年

steps.prompt: What does 語言中心 mean?
steps.explanation: 語言 means language and 中心 means center.

steps.prompt: 大學 means…
steps.explanation: 大學 is university.

lessons.title: How Many Years Do You Need?
lessons.subtitle: Use 需要 to connect the two-part plan to the total duration.

steps.prompt: 需要 means…
steps.explanation: 需要 is the this lesson verb 'to need.'

steps.prompt: Which sentence says 'So I need five years'?
steps.explanation: 需要 means 'to need.' In context, the omitted subject is the speaker: 'So I need five years.'

lessons.title: That Will Cost Money
lessons.subtitle: Learn the cost reaction and the word for a scholarship.

steps.prompt: What does 花 mean in 這得花不少錢?
steps.explanation: Here 花 is the verb 'to spend (time or money).' The whole sentence can naturally be translated as 'That will cost quite a lot of money.'

steps.prompt: Which word means scholarship?
steps.explanation: 獎學金 is scholarship.

lessons.title: If the Grades Aren't Good
lessons.subtitle: Learn 成績 and retrieve the earlier 要是…就… conditional in the scholarship warning.

steps.prompt: 成績 means…
steps.explanation: 成績 is the word for grades.

steps.prompt: According to 要是成績不好，就沒獎學金了, what happens if the grades are not good?
options: The study plan becomes five years.
steps.explanation: 就沒獎學金了 means the scholarship will no longer be available; 要是…就… links that result to the condition.

lessons.title: Unit 34 Review
lessons.subtitle: Study plans, duration, sequence, cost, scholarship, grades, listening, and handwriting retrieval.

steps.prompt: Which this lesson word means 'to plan to'?
steps.explanation: 計畫 is the lesson verb 'to plan to.'

steps.prompt: Which pair correctly matches 'long (time)' / 'time'?
steps.explanation: 久 describes long duration; 時間 is the noun 'time.'

steps.prompt: Which sentence correctly sequences studying language first and university second?
options: 他計畫在臺灣先學語言，再念大學。
他計畫在臺灣再學語言，先念大學。
steps.answer: 他計畫在臺灣先學語言，再念大學。
steps.explanation: This is the rule here this pattern sequence: 先 marks language study first and 再 marks university study next.

steps.prompt: Which word means 'scholarship'?
steps.explanation: 獎學金 means scholarship.

steps.prompt: In 這得花不少錢, what does 花 mean?
steps.explanation: Here 花 is the lesson verb 'to spend (time or money).'

steps.prompt: Which sentence correctly uses 先…再… for a past sequence?
options: 我昨天晚上先寫功課，再看電視。
我昨天晚上再寫功課，先看電視。
steps.answer: 我昨天晚上先寫功課，再看電視。
steps.explanation: The rule here uses 先…再… for past as well as future sequences: 先 marks Event 1 and 再 marks Event 2.

steps.prompt: Which sentence correctly reuses the earlier condition pattern?
options: 要是成績不好，就沒獎學金了。
先成績不好，再沒獎學金了。
steps.answer: 要是成績不好，就沒獎學金了。
steps.explanation: The condition uses 要是…就…, not 先…再….

tokens: 我先在語言中心念一年

steps.prompt: Listen for the planning verb.
steps.audioText: 你計畫在臺灣學多久的中文？
steps.explanation: 計畫 is the planning verb.

steps.prompt: Listen for what marks the first action.
steps.explanation: 先 marks the first action.

steps.prompt: Listen for the scholarship word.
steps.explanation: 獎學金 means scholarship.

newVocabulary.note: A prerequisite-repair item: this lesson assumes 臺灣, but the cumulative Hanzi Steps index had not formally introduced the word or its characters.
this lesson lists 計畫 as a verb; compare earlier 打算 'plan/intend'.
In this lesson, Taiwan Mandarin uses 念 for studying a subject or attending a course of study.
sense here is the verb 'to spend (time or money).'

臺.note: 臺 is the Traditional character used in 臺灣. Hanzi Steps formally adds it here because the cumulative curriculum had used Taiwan as context without first teaching this character.
臺.memory: Build 士 and 口 at the top, place the 冖 cover through the middle, then finish with 至 at the bottom.

parts.label: 士
parts.name: scholar component
parts.description: The first three strokes form 士 at the top.

parts.label: 口
parts.name: mouth component
parts.description: The next three strokes form 口.

parts.label: 冖
parts.name: cover component
parts.description: Two strokes make the cover across the middle.

parts.label: 至
parts.name: arrive component
parts.description: The final six strokes form 至 below the cover.

灣.meaning: bay; gulf (second character of 臺灣)
灣.note: 灣 is first-tone wān. In 臺灣 it is the second character of the place name Taiwan.
灣.memory: Keep the three-dot water component 氵 narrow on the left; the dense 彎 component occupies the full right side.

parts.label: 氵
parts.name: water component
parts.description: The first three strokes form 氵.

parts.label: 彎
parts.name: bend component
parts.description: The remaining twenty-two strokes form 彎 on the right.

畫.meaning: draw; second character of 計畫
畫.note: 畫 is fourth-tone huà. Here, learn it inside 計畫 'to plan to'; do not translate the two characters separately when reading the compound.
畫.memory: Write the 聿-like upper frame first, build 田 beneath it, and close with the long final 一.

parts.label: 聿
parts.name: brush-like upper component
parts.description: The first six strokes form the brush-like upper structure.

parts.label: 田
parts.name: field component
parts.description: The next five strokes form 田.

parts.label: 一
parts.name: final horizontal
parts.description: The last stroke closes the character along the bottom.

先.note: 先 is first-tone xiān. Put it before the first action in 先…再… to mark what happens first.
先.memory: The four-stroke upper shape stands above 儿, whose two legs spread at the bottom.

parts.name: upper shape
parts.description: The first four strokes form the compact upper structure.

parts.label: 儿
parts.name: legs component
parts.description: The final two strokes form 儿.

念.note: 念 is fourth-tone niàn. In this lesson it is the Taiwan Mandarin verb 'to study,' as in 念中文 or 念大學.
念.memory: 今 sits on top of 心: four strokes above and four heart strokes below.

parts.label: 今
parts.name: now component
parts.description: The first four strokes form 今.

parts.label: 心
parts.name: heart component
parts.description: The final four strokes form 心.

語.note: 語 is third-tone yǔ. Together with 言 it forms 語言, 'language.'
語.memory: 言 occupies the left seven strokes; 吾 fills the right seven.

parts.label: 言
parts.name: speech component
parts.description: The first seven strokes form 言.

parts.label: 吾
parts.name: right component
parts.description: The final seven strokes form 吾.

言.note: 言 is second-tone yán. Learn it here as the second character of 語言.
言.memory: Start with the top mark and horizontal lines, then finish the lower 口-shaped speech block.

parts.label: 亠
parts.name: top mark
parts.description: The first two strokes establish the top of 言.

parts.label: 二
parts.name: middle lines
parts.description: The next two strokes form the paired middle lines.

parts.label: 口
parts.name: mouth shape
parts.description: The final three strokes form the lower 口.

需.note: 需 is first-tone xū. In this lesson, learn it inside 需要 'to need.'
需.memory: 雨 forms the eight-stroke top; 而 supplies the six-stroke lower block.

parts.label: 雨
parts.name: rain component
parts.description: The first eight strokes form 雨.

parts.label: 而
parts.name: lower component
parts.description: The final six strokes form 而.

花.note: 花 is first-tone huā. In 這得花不少錢 it is the lesson verb 'to spend (time or money),' not the noun 'flower.'
花.memory: The four-stroke 艹 sits across the top; 化 forms the four strokes below.

parts.label: 艹
parts.name: grass component
parts.description: The first four strokes form the Taiwan-form 艹 top.

parts.label: 化
parts.name: change component
parts.description: The final four strokes form 化.

獎.note: 獎 is third-tone jiǎng. In 獎學金 it refers to an award or scholarship fund.
獎.memory: 將 fills the upper part; 犬 forms the four-stroke bottom. The last dot is the final stroke of 犬.

parts.label: 將
parts.name: upper component
parts.description: The first eleven strokes form 將.

parts.label: 犬
parts.name: dog component
parts.description: The final four strokes form 犬; its dot is written last.

金.note: 金 is first-tone jīn. In 獎學金 it contributes the sense of money or funds.
金.memory: The top opens outward, a central vertical anchors the character, and the final horizontal closes the base.

parts.label: 金
parts.name: whole character
parts.description: All eight strokes form the balanced 金 character.

成.note: 成 is second-tone chéng. Here it is the first character of 成績, 'grades; academic results.'
成.memory: Keep the inner bend compact while the long slanting stroke and final hook open the character to the right.

parts.label: 成
parts.name: whole character
parts.description: All six strokes form the compact 成 shape.

績.note: 績 is first-tone jī. In 成績 it completes the word for grades or academic results.
績.memory: 糹 is the six-stroke thread component on the left; 責 forms the eleven-stroke right side.

parts.label: 糹
parts.name: thread component
parts.description: The first six strokes form 糹.

parts.label: 責
parts.name: responsibility component
parts.description: The final eleven strokes form 責.

u34-first-then.title: First…, then… with 先…再…
u34-first-then.pattern: Subject + 先 + Event 1，(Subject) + 再 + Event 2
u34-first-then.explanation: 先…再… presents the temporal sequence of two consecutive events. Put 先 before the first event and 再 before the next event. The rule here explicitly uses the pattern for past and future sequences, and its drills also include habitual sequences such as 每天…. When the same subject continues into the second event, the examples normally leave it understood before 再. Here 再 means 'then / next,' not merely 'again.'

examples.pinyin: Wǒ xiān niàn Zhōngwén, zài niàn dàxué.
examples.meaning: I study Chinese first, then attend university.

examples.text: 我想先吃晚飯，再給媽媽打電話。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng xiān chī wǎnfàn, zài gěi māma dǎ diànhuà.
examples.meaning: I want to eat dinner first, then call my mom.

examples.text: 我昨天晚上先寫功課，再看電視。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zuótiān wǎnshang xiān xiě gōngkè, zài kàn diànshì.
examples.meaning: Last night I did my homework first, then watched TV.

examples.text: 我明天先去圖書館看書，再去超市買東西。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ míngtiān xiān qù túshūguǎn kàn shū, zài qù chāoshì mǎi dōngxi.
examples.meaning: Tomorrow I will go to the library to read first, then go to the supermarket to buy things.

u34-first-then.remember: 先 marks Event 1; 再 marks Event 2. Keep the two actions in the real order you mean.

u34-plan.text: 你計畫在臺灣學多久的中文？
u34-plan.pinyin: Nǐ jìhuà zài Táiwān xué duō jiǔ de Zhōngwén?
u34-plan.meaning: How long do you plan to study Chinese in Taiwan?
u34-plan.note: This is the opening question of this lesson the conversation. The reply is 五年。 計畫 is close to the earlier 打算; here both can express an intended plan.

u34-time.text: 為什麼要這麼久的時間？
u34-time.pinyin: Wèishénme yào zhème jiǔ de shíjiān?
u34-time.note: This follows the reply 五年。 久 describes a long duration; 時間 is the noun 'time.'

u34-sequence-simple.pinyin: Wǒ xiān niàn Zhōngwén, zài niàn dàxué.
u34-sequence-simple.meaning: I will study Chinese first, then attend university.
u34-sequence-simple.note: 先 marks the first action and 再 marks the next action.

u34-sequence-source.text: 我先在語言中心念一年，再念四年大學。
u34-sequence-source.pinyin: Wǒ xiān zài yǔyán zhōngxīn niàn yì nián, zài niàn sì nián dàxué.
u34-sequence-source.meaning: I will first study for one year at a language center, then study at university for four years.
u34-sequence-source.note: This keeps the study sequence from this lesson the conversation. 年 is the measure word for years.
tokens: 我先在語言中心念一年

u34-need.note: 需要 means 'to need.' The subject 我 is understood from the preceding context.

u34-cost.pinyin: Zhè děi huā bù shǎo qián!
u34-cost.meaning: That will cost quite a lot of money!
u34-cost.note: 花 is the lesson verb 'to spend (time or money).' In this context, 這得花不少錢 is naturally translated as 'That will cost quite a lot of money.' 得 is read děi 'must / have to,' a reading already encountered in Unit 33.

u34-scholarship.meaning: Right, but I have a scholarship.
u34-scholarship.note: This preserves the contrast: the study plan costs a lot, but the speaker has a scholarship. 不過 is review from Unit 33.

u34-grades.text: 要是成績不好，就沒獎學金了。你呢？
u34-grades.pinyin: Yàoshi chéngjī bù hǎo, jiù méi jiǎngxuéjīn le. Nǐ ne?
u34-grades.meaning: If my grades are poor, then I won't have a scholarship anymore. And you?
u34-grades.note: This completes the speaker turn. 要是…就… is the earlier condition pattern; the final 了 marks the changed result, and 你呢？ hands the conversation back to the other speaker.
